cybersecurity.framework: the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and ISO/IEC 27001
cybersecurity.oversight: the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors

scenario.summary: Stonegate Sciences experienced reduced usage from a significant customer during fiscal 2025 after that customer migrated a portion of its workloads to a competing observability vendor, contributing to the year's thin operating margin.

facts.driver: a significant customer migrated a portion of its workloads to a competing observability platform
facts.response: continued investment in platform capabilities and customer success to limit further displacement
